articoli.titolo: Dominic Calvert-Lewin 'showed respect by standing' as others took knee for racism campaign - Daniel Farke
articoli.estratto: Leeds boss Daniel Farke has said that striker Dominic Calvert-Lewin showed "respect" after not taking the knee prior to Leeds United's draw with Manchester United on Sunday.

articoli.titolo: Fabian Hürzeler tells Brighton fans: Have a beer and don't look at Premier League table
articoli.estratto: Fabian Hürzeler has told Brighton & Hove Albion fans to "enjoy a beer" and not look at the Premier League table to celebrate their win over Crystal Palace.

articoli.titolo: Brighton beat Crystal Palace after Diego Gómez scores longest-range Premier League goal since 2017
articoli.estratto: Diego Gómez's halfway-line strike for Brighton against Crystal Palace was the furthest a Premier League goal has been scored since November 2017.

articoli.titolo: Shakhtar's Champions League win vs. AEK was more than just a game
articoli.estratto: Shakhtar Donetsk haven't played at home since 2014 due to the war, and this season, their Champions League home games are at Chelsea's Stamford Bridge. Wednesday's win was a reminder of how absurd their situation is.
